Excessive menstruation with great weak-
ness. Passive uterine hemorrhages. [Ust.; Trill.;

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Corrosive itching. Great sensitiveness of
skin, with redness and soreness from slight rubbing.
Eczema of head and face; pustules, itching, burning,
and offensive odor. Hair matted together.
